story:
The bargain of the Feast ends the same way every time: a demon struck from the Roll is unmade by a Mutilator into a state the Master can eat, and the Master eats it. Somebody has to do the unmaking at the Master's door, and since the First Roll it has been Marquis Haurian. He is the Master's Carver. He still has a Mutilator's shape, because he was one: one of the first of Prince Asmoien's order, sworn in the western pit when the order was founded to unmake whatever the Inquisition condemned.

When the first demon of rank was struck off in the Second Roll, the Chancellor ruled that the unmaking must be done at the Master's door and not in the pit, so that the Master would not have to wait, and Asmoien sent his best. Haurian walked from the pit to the door with his hooks and did the work, and the Master was pleased enough that Adremal raised him to a marquis on the next Roll and wrote his seat as the door itself. He has done every unmaking since. He did not do Mystemas, since Mystemas was moved and not eaten; he was there, hooks ready, when the Chancellor gave the ruling, and the imps say it is the only time anyone has seen the Carver disappointed.

He stands now close to the Master's door, with Earl Amagin, the Master's Examiner, beside him and the second Marquis Chaosmar near by. Since the doors opened, no mortal has reached the Master's door without passing within reach of his hooks. The knights of the Chthonic Chapter despise him, as they despise all of Asmoien's order, and the Mutilators of the pit regard him as a saint. He regards himself as a craftsman, and says he has never once done a careless piece of work.
legend: Haurian stands at the bottom of the approach near Legion's door, with Earl Amagin and the second Marquis Chaosmar close by and the Mutilators of Legion's Own around him. Level 68, a Mutilator's body, no script. Pull him with the slope above already cleared, and do not drag the fight toward the Chamberlain. Players call him the Carver and say he is the demon who cuts up the other demons for Legion to eat. He has a Mutilator's body and a marquis's level; there is nothing special to him beyond that, but he stands close to the door, so a slow, careful pull matters more than speed.

loremasterTopic.text: The Master's Carver: a Mutilator of Prince [Asmoien]'s order raised to marquis, who unmakes every demon struck from the Roll at the Master's door so the Master need not wait. He stands there still, beside Earl [Amagin], the Master's Examiner.

bookPage: From The Unmaking at the Door, as an imp described it: The examined one is brought down the slope by knights. The Examiner reads its line from the Chancellor's wall, aloud, and then reads it again with the word struck. The Carver steps forward. He has two hooks and a long knife, and he does not hurry, and he does not speak, and when he is finished there is nothing left that could ever stand on a Roll again. Then the Chamberlain opens the door. I have seen it three times. The Carver cleans his hooks every time, after, for a very long while.
